title: The legend of Kartikeya
introduction: Sage Vishvamitra continues his narration about the earthly course of Ganga, her begetting Kaartikeya, Krittika-stars breast-feeding that boy, gods naming that boy as Kaarthikeya, and that boy's anointment as the Chief of Celestial Armies.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे सप्तत्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 37th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तप्यमाने तदा देवे सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः |
सेनापतिमभीप्सन्तः पितामहमुपागमन्
verses.iast:
tapyamāne tadā deve sa indrāḥ sa agni purogamāḥ |
senāpatim abhīpsantaḥ pitāmaham upāgaman
verses.translation: "While god Shiva is undertaking ascesis thus, then the gods desiring an Army Chief for celestial forces have arrived in the audience of Forefather Brahma, along with Indra and keeping Fire-god at their fore." Sage Vishvamitra continued his narration to Rama.

glosses.meaning: of god Shiva, while undertaking ascesis
with, Fire-god, keeping afore - as leader
tlowards Forefather - Brahma, arrived at the nearby of.

verses.devanagari:
ततोऽब्रुवन् सुराः सर्वे भगवन्तं पितामहम् |
प्रणिपत्य सुराः राम सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः
verses.iast:
tato abruvan surāḥ sarve bhagavantam pitāmaham |
praṇipatya surāḥ rāma sa indrāḥ sa agni purogamāḥ
verses.translation: "On approaching the Forefather Brahma, oh, Rama, all of the celestials headed by Fire-god and along with Indra have venerated and then spoke this to him.

glosses.meaning: with Fire-god, keeping ahead of their delegation

verses.devanagari:
येन सेनापतिर्देव दत्तो भगवता पुरा |
स तपः परमास्थाय तप्यते स्म सहोमया
verses.iast:
yena senāpatiḥ deva datto bhagavatā purā |
sa tapaḥ param āsthāya tapyate sma saha umayā
verses.translation: " 'Oh, god Brahma, he who has hypothetically given a Chief of Celestial Army in the form of his potence that god Shiva is undertaking a supreme ascesis, indeed along with Goddess Uma.
notes: The potence that is stirred from Shiva and given to earth as in last chapter has not yet materialised as Kaarthikeya.

glosses.meaning: army, chief, is given - in the form of Shiva's potence in a hypothetical way

verses.devanagari:
यदत्रानंतरं कार्यं लोकानां हितकाम्यया |
संविधत्स्व विधानज्ञ त्वं हि नः परमा गतिः
verses.iast:
yat atra anantaram kāryam lokānām hita kāṃyayā |
saṃvidhatsva vidhānajña tvam hi naḥ paramā gatiḥ
verses.translation: " 'Looking forward for the welfare of the worlds, oh, knower of the procedures, Brahma, you may order us clearly what is to be done next, as you alone are our ultimate recourse.

glosses.meaning: for worlds, welfare, intent on - looking forward
later, which, action - what next is to be done
fully, verily, order - let it be ordered clearly
you alone, for us, ultimate, recourse.

verses.devanagari:
देवतानां वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वलोकपितामहः |
सान्त्वयन् मधुरैर्वाक्यैस्त्रिदशानिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
devatānām vacaḥ śrutvā sarva loka pitāmahaḥ |
sāntvayan madhuraiḥ vākyaiḥ tridaśān idam abravīt
verses.translation: "On listening the words of gods, Brahma, the Forefather of all the worlds, soothingly spoke this to the celestials with sweet words.

verses.devanagari:
शैलपुत्र्या यदुक्तं तन्न प्रजाः स्वासु पत्निषु |
तस्या वचनमक्लिष्टं सत्यमेव न संशयः
verses.iast:
śaila putryā yat uktam tat na prajāḥ svāsu patniṣu |
tasyā vacanam akliṣṭam satyam eva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: " 'What the Daughter of Mountain, namely Goddess Uma, has said that 'you shall have no posterity in your own wives' is true and it cannot be decried, and it is unambiguous too.

glosses.meaning: what, by mountain, daughter - Uma, is said
her, sentence, not, to be put to shame - decried

verses.devanagari:
इयमाकाशगंगा यस्यां पुत्रं हुताशनः |
जनयिष्यति देवानां सेनापतिमरिंदमम्
verses.iast:
iyam ākāśa gaṅgā yasyām putram hutāśanaḥ |
janayiṣyati devānām senāpatim arindamam
verses.translation: " 'In whom the Fire-god can procreate an enemy-destroying Chief of Celestial Armies, such an empyreal Ganga is there.

glosses.meaning: who can give birth to - Fire-god who can procreate

verses.devanagari:
ज्येष्ठा शैलेन्द्रदुहिता मानयिष्यति तं सुतम् |
उमायास्तद्बहुमतं भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.iast:
jyeṣṭhā śailendra duhitā mānayiṣyati tam sutam |
umāyāḥ tat bahumatam bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: " 'The elder daughter King of Mountains, namely Ganga, will graciously welcome the offspring from Fire-god, and that act of Ganga in welcoming the offspring through Fire-god will also be pleasurable in many ways to the younger daughter of King of Mountains, namely Uma, no doubt about it.' So said Brahma to all the gods.

glosses.meaning: that - act of Ganga in welcoming boy
to Uma, in many ways, pleasurable, it will be

verses.devanagari:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य कृतार्था रघुनन्दन |
प्रणिपत्य सुराः सर्वे पितामहमपूजयन्
verses.iast:
tat śrutvā vacanam tasya kṛtārthā raghunandana |
praṇipatya surāḥ sarve pitāmaham apūjayan
verses.translation: "On hearing those words of Brahma, oh, Rama, the delight of Raghu's dynasty, all the gods have praisefully worshipped him, as their ends are achieved at the bidding fair of Brahma.

glosses.meaning: his - Brahma's, that, sentence, on hearing
with achieved, ends - at this bidding fair of Brahma
at Forefather, sang the praises, worshipped.

verses.devanagari:
ते गत्वा परमं राम कैलासं धातुमण्डितम् |
अग्निं नियोजयामासुः पुत्रार्थं सर्वदेवताः
verses.iast:
te gatvā paramam rāma kailāsam dhātu maṇḍitam |
agnim niyojayāmāsuḥ putrārtham sarva devatāḥ
verses.translation: "On going to that supreme Mt. Kailash, oh, Rama, which is heaped up with many ores, all of those gods have assigned the Fire-god to father a son.

glosses.meaning: to supreme, to Mt. Kailash, on going to
son, purpose of - to father the son

verses.devanagari:
देवकार्यमिदं देव समाधत्स्व हुताशन |
शैलपुत्र्यां महातेजो गंगायां तेज उत्सृज
verses.iast:
deva kāryam idam deva samādhatsva hutāśana |
śaila putryām mahātejo gaṅgāyām teja utsṛja
verses.translation: " 'Oh, Fire-god, you please coordinate the mission of gods, oh, great-resplendent god of Fire, you may release the potence of Shiva, which you have contained so far, in the daughter of King of Mountains, namely River Ganga.' Thus, all gods have requested the Fire-god.

verses.devanagari:
देवतानां प्रतिज्ञाय गंगामभ्येत्य पावकः |
गर्भं धारय वै देवि देवतानामिदं प्रियम्
verses.iast:
devatānām pratijñāya gaṅgām abhyetya pāvakaḥ |
garbham dhāraya vai devi devatānām idam priyam
verses.translation: "On assuring the gods that he will do his best, the Fire-god approached Ganga entreating, 'Oh, Goddess Ganga, you verily bear pregnancy with the potence of Shiva, since this is the select process of all the gods.' So said Fire-god to River Ganga.

glosses.meaning: to gods, on assuring - that he will do his best

verses.devanagari:
इत्येतद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दिव्यं रूपमधारयत् |
स तस्या महिमां दृष्ट्वा समंतादवकीर्यत
verses.iast:
iti etat vacanam śrutvā divyam rūpam adhārayat |
sa tasyā mahimām dṛṣṭvā samantāt avakīryata
verses.translation: "On listening that sentence of Fire-god, River Ganga adopted a celestial form readying herself, and on seeing her glorious mien the Fire-god seeped throughout her.

glosses.meaning: thus, that, sentence - of Fire-god, on listening

verses.devanagari:
समंततस्तदा देवीमभ्यषिंचत पावकः |
सर्वस्रोतांसि पूर्णानि गंगाया रघुनन्दन
verses.iast:
samantataḥ tadā devīm abhyaṣiñcata pāvakaḥ |
sarva srotāṃsi pūrṇāni gaṅgāyā raghunandana
verses.translation: "The Fire-god then drenched River Ganga from all over with the potence of Shiva which he contained so far, oh, Raghu's delight Rama, and every rill and channel of Ganga is replete with it.

glosses.meaning: Goddess - Ganga, all over, drenched her with the potence of Shiva
every, channel [rill of Ganga,] replete with.

verses.devanagari:
तमुवाच ततो गंगा सर्वदेवपुरोगमम् |
अशक्ता धारणे देव तेजस्तव समुद्धतम्
दह्यमानाग्निना तेन संप्रव्यथितचेतना |
verses.iast:
tam uvāca tato gaṅgā sarva deva purogamam |
aśaktā dhāraṇe deva tejaḥ tava samuddhatam
dahyamānā agninā tena sampravyathita cetanā |
verses.translation: "River Ganga then spoke this to the Fire-god who is in the lead of all gods, 'oh, god, I am incapable to bear up the rampant fervour of yours, and while being burnt with the fire of god Shiva compounded with that of yours my life-force is very highly tortured.'

glosses.meaning: all, god, who is in forefront of - Fire-god
your, intense heat - fervour compounded with that of Shiva
by that, fire [of the potence of Shiva,] while being burnt

verses.devanagari:
अथाब्रवीदिदं गङ्गां सर्वदेवहुताशनः
इह हैमवते पार्श्वे गर्भोऽयं संनिवेश्यताम् |
verses.iast:
atha abravīt idam gaṅgām sarva deva hutāśanaḥ
iha haimavate pārśve garbho ayam saṃniveśyatām |
verses.translation: "He who consumes fire-oblations on behalf of all the gods, that Fire-god seeing the miserable condition of River Ganga then spoke this to her, ''you may lay away that embryo here at the side of Himalayan Mountains.' So said Fire-god to River Ganga.

glosses.meaning: all, god's, fire-oblations, consumer - consumer of fire oblations on behalf of all gods
to Ganga, this, said - on seeing her miserable plight
here, at Himalayan Mountains, by the side of [at the foot of]

verses.devanagari:
श्रुत्वा त्वग्निवचो गंगा तं गर्भमतिभास्वरम्
उत्ससर्ज महातेजाः स्रोतोभ्यो हि तदानघ |
verses.iast:
śrutvā tu agni vaco gaṅgā tam garbham atibhāsvaram
utsasarja mahātejāḥ srotobhyo hi tadā anagha |
verses.translation: "Oh, great-resplendent Rama, on hearing the words of Fire-god, oh, charming prince Rama, River Ganga indeed ejected that great-radiant embryo of Shiva from all her rills and channels.

glosses.meaning: Fire-god's, words, on hearing, on her part
from her channels [and rills,] ejected, indeed.

verses.devanagari:
यदस्या निर्गतं तस्मात्तप्तजांबूनदप्रभम्
कांचनं धरणीं प्राप्तं हिरण्यमतुलप्रभम् |
verses.iast:
yat asyā nirgatam tasmāt tapta jāmbūnada prabham
kāñcanam dharaṇīm prāptam hiraṇyam atula prabham |
verses.translation: "Which refulgent embryo with the glitter of molten gold has emerged from River Ganga is there that has reached earth, and from that the silver, and even the gold with its matchless dazzle have emerged.

glosses.meaning: molten, gold, with a glitter of
un, balanceable - matchless, in dazzle, gold

verses.devanagari:
ताम्रं कार्ष्णायसं चैव तैक्ष्ण्यादेवाभिजायत
मलं तस्याभवत्तत्र त्रपु सीसकमेव च |
तदेतद्धरणीं प्राप्य नानाधातुरवर्धत
verses.iast:
tāmram kārṣṇāyasam caiva taikṣṇyāt eva abhijāyata
malam tasya abhavat tatra trapu sīsakam eva ca |
tat etat dharaṇīm prāpya nānā dhātuḥ avardhata
verses.translation: "In that process, copper and iron are also generated from that combustion of fires of Shiva and Fire-god, and the residua have become tin and lead, and thus that embryo on reaching the earth has evolved itself into various other elements also.

glosses.meaning: its - of the semen of Shiva
that, thus - such as it is - that potence of Shiva

verses.devanagari:
निक्षिप्तमात्रे गर्भे तु तेजोभिरभिरंजितम् |
सर्वं पर्वतसंनद्धं सौवर्णमभवद्वनम्
verses.iast:
nikṣipta mātre garbhe tu tejobhiḥ abhirañjitam |
sarvam parvata saṃnaddham sauvarṇam abhavat vanam
verses.translation: "But, just when that embryo is laid down on Himalayan mountains, entire reed-garden sprouted on that mountain is made brilliant by that glittering embryo and the reed-garden itself has become golden.

glosses.meaning: embryo, is laid down, just when, but

verses.devanagari:
जातरूपमिति ख्यातं तदा प्रभृति राघव |
सुवर्णं पुरुषव्याघ्र हुताशनसमप्रभम् |
तृणवृक्षलतागुल्मं सर्वं भवति कांचनम्
verses.iast:
jātarūpam iti khyātam tadā prabhṛti rāghava |
suvarṇam puruṣavyāghra hutāśana sama prabham |
tṛṇa vṛkśa latā gulmam sarvam bhavati kāñcanam
verses.translation: "Oh, tigerly-man, from then onwards the gold with its brilliance equalling that of the Fire-god is renowned by the name of jaata ruupa , one that retains its birth-time form, and oh, Raghava, everything on the mountain, say grass, trees, climbers, and shrubs, all have become golden.
notes: The gold has the etymological name of jāta rūpa 'birth-time-form.' As and when Ganga's disgorged her womb there appeared a forest of fire like gold. So, the gold glowing like fire is called gold at many places in Ramayana. Pt. Satya Vrat.

glosses.meaning: grass, tress, climbers, shrubs kaancanam bhavati = golden, they have become.

verses.devanagari:
तं कुमारं ततो जातं सेन्द्राः सहमरुद्गणाः |
क्षीरसंभावनार्थाय कृत्तिकाः समयोजयन्
verses.iast:
tam kumāram tato jātam sa indrāḥ saha marud gaṇāḥ |
kṣīra sambhāvana arthāya kṛttikāḥ samayojayan
verses.translation: "Then for the boy who took birth from the embryo deposited in Himalayas, the Wind-gods along with Indra have arranged Krittika stars to simultaneously suckle him.

glosses.meaning: birthed, him, the son - from the embryo
at a time - to suckle the baby simultaneously
milk, to nourish with, for the purpose of - to suckle and nourish

verses.devanagari:
ताः क्षीरं जातमात्रस्य कृत्वा समयमुत्तमम् |
ददुः पुत्रोऽयमस्माकं सर्वासामिति निश्चिताः
verses.iast:
tāḥ kṣīram jāta mātrasya kṛtvā samayam uttamam |
daduḥ putro ayam asmākam sarvāsām iti niścitāḥ
verses.translation: "Those Krittika stars have decided among themselves that 'this boy shall be the son for all of us,' and on making such a best resolve they suckled the just born boy.

glosses.meaning: he is, our, all of us, let him be the son - let him be the son for all of us
best, resolve, on making jaata maatrasya = who is born, just then

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तु देवताः सर्वाः कार्तिकेय इति ब्रुवन् |
पुत्रस्त्रैलोक्यविख्यातो भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.iast:
tataḥ tu devatāḥ sarvāḥ kārtikeya iti bruvan |
putraḥ trailokya vikhyāto bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: "All the gods have then said, 'this boy will be renowned in all the three world as Kaarthikeya, as Krittika-stars have suckled him, with any doubt.'

glosses.meaning: in three worlds, renowned, he will be

verses.devanagari:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा स्कन्नं गर्भपरिस्रवे |
स्नापयन् परया लक्ष्म्या दीप्यमानं यथानलम्
verses.iast:
teṣām tat vacanam śrutvā skannam garbha parisrave |
snāpayan parayā lakṣṃyā dīpyamānam yathā analam
verses.translation: "On hearing that blessing of gods Krittika stars gave a wash to that excellently auspicious boy who is radiant like fire, and who slid down from the secretion of the womb of Ganga.

glosses.meaning: their of gods, that, sentence, on hearing - on hearing gods blessings
from womb of Ganga, secretion, who slid down

verses.devanagari:
स्कंद इत्यब्रुवन् देवाः स्कन्नं गर्भपरिस्रवात् |
कार्तिकेयं महाबाहुं काकुत्स्थ ज्वलनोपमम्
verses.iast:
skanda iti abruvan devāḥ skannam garbha parisravāt |
kārtikeyam mahābāhum kākutstha jvalana upamam
verses.translation: "And gods called that boy, oh, Rama of Kakutstha, whose glow is like that of flaring fire and who is ambidextrous as 'Skanda' for he slid down from the secretions of a womb.

glosses.meaning: flare of fire, similar to - glow
from womb's, secretions, who slid down
Skanda, thus, they called him - in its lexical meaning - to slid, who glissaded.

verses.devanagari:
प्रादुर्भूतं ततः क्षीरं कृत्तिकानामनुत्तमम् |
षण्णां षडाननो भूत्वा जग्राह स्तनजं पयः
verses.iast:
prādur.hbhūtam tataḥ kṣīram kṛttikānām anuttamam |
ṣaṇṇām ṣaḍ ānano bhūtvā jagrāha stanajam payaḥ
verses.translation: "Then an unexcelled milk instantly came forth from the breasts of the six Krittika-stars, and becoming a six-faced one that boy too sucked that milk from the six Krittika-stars at the same time.
notes: It is said that each of the six Krittika-stars came forward to give her milk firstly to this boy. Observing their eagerness to feed him, Skanda / Kaartikeya made his one face into six and sucked all the milk of all the six stars and become an adolescent boy in day. Hence he looked like the one with six faces, by which he is called ṣan mukha , six-faced deity. Later he argues with his father Shiva that he is superior to Shiva, because he has five-faces of Shiva, plus his own, totalling to a six, and he is a six-faced deity, superior to the five-faced god, namely Shiva. In another way, the boy by birth is dextrous and he sucked the milk of all the six mothers in split second with one face, but it appeared to all deities that the boy has been sucking milk with six faces, i.e., with rapid-face-movement. Thus on establishing his ambidextrous personality, the gods nominate him as the Chief of Celestial Army.

glosses.meaning: of six of them, the Krittika stars

verses.devanagari:
गृहीत्वा क्षीरमेकाह्ना सुकुमारवपुस्तदा |
अजयत् स्वेन वीर्येण दैत्यसैन्यगणान्विभुः
verses.iast:
gṛhītvā kṣīram eka ahnā sukumāra vapuḥ tadā |
ajayat svena vīryeṇa daitya sainya gaṇān vibhuḥ
verses.translation: "On sipping the milk just for one day he became an adolescent boy on that day itself, and even though he is of delicate constitution as a boy, that taskmaster triumphed over the army troops of demons by his own vigour.

verses.devanagari:
सुरसेनागणपतिमभ्यषिंचन्महाद्युतिम् |
ततस्तममराः सर्वे समेत्याग्निपुरोगमाः
verses.iast:
sura senā gaṇa patim abhyaṣiñcat mahādyutim |
tataḥ tam amarāḥ sarve sametya agni purogamāḥ
verses.translation: "All of the celestial have then come together under the leadership of Fire-god and they anointed that highly resplendent boy, Skanda, or Kaarthikeya, as the Chief of Celestial Army troops.

glosses.meaning: Fire god, keeping afore as leader

verses.devanagari:
एष ते राम गंगाया विस्तरोऽभिहितो मया |
कुमारसंभवश्चैव धन्यः पुण्यस्तथैव च
verses.iast:
eṣa te rāma gaṅgāyā vistaro abhihito mayā |
kumāra sambhavaḥ caiva dhanyaḥ puṇyaḥ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: "This way, I have vividly narrated the legend of Ganga to you, oh, Rama, like that the Divine and Meritorious legend of the emergence of Kumara, namely Skanda is also narrated.

glosses.meaning: by me, to you, of Ganga

verses.devanagari:
भक्तश्च यः कार्तिकेये काकुत्स्थ भुवि मानवः |
आयुष्मान् पुत्र पौत्रश्च स्कन्दसालोक्यतां व्रजेत्
verses.iast:
bhaktaḥ ca yaḥ kārtikeye kākutstha bhuvi mānavaḥ |
āyuṣmān putra pautraḥ ca skanda sālokyatām vrajate
verses.translation: "He who is a devotee of Kartikeyaa, oh, Rama of Kakutstha, he thrives with longevity, also with sons, grandsons on this humanly earth in his mortal life, and on its conclusion he becomes one with Skanda on journeying to Skanda's abode.

glosses.meaning: of Kaartikeya, devotee, if he were to be
of Skanda, in his abode [identical,] he goes, attains.
